# Stryker Slev Law Group

> > California real estate law firm specializing in property transfers, zoning approvals, commercial development, and regulatory compliance in San Diego.

Stryker Slev Law Group provides comprehensive real estate legal services throughout California, with particular focus on San Diego County. The firm handles property transactions, title issues, contract disputes, custom home building, zoning permits, entitlements, and commercial property development matters.
